name: Received blocks (guide)
notes: Incoming material. Block specs are supplier-controlled (out-of-facility SPOS).

name: Ligation reaction mass
carries: full-length strand + n-1 + unreacted blocks + partial products + ligase + ATP/AMP/PPi + splint(if used)
notes: Species list drives the clearance matrix.

name: Clarified ligation pool
notes: After depth/clarifying filtration and/or immobilised-enzyme separation.

name: Diafiltration buffer
notes: BUF-DF. Final DV must exchange into spray-dryable matrix (excipient + minimal/volatile salts).

name: UF/DF permeate (waste)
notes: Largest aqueous waste volume; scales with diavolumes.

name: UF/DF retentate (concentrated strand/duplex)
carries: purified strand or duplex in matrix
notes: Anneal point (single strand vs duplex) is Q-001.

name: Evaporator condensate (waste)
notes: Recoverable as clean condensate; volume = water removed.

name: Drug substance powder
notes: Product form (duplex powder vs two strand powders) tied to Q-001.
